_comment: A relieved regiment backs out of the line facing the enemy. A tired player Infantry unit (uid0) holds an engaged enemy while a fresh one (uid1) waits behind it; the player box-selects the fresh unit and right-clicks the engaged ally at tick 200 -- a RELIEF order. The reliever takes over the fight and the relieved unit peels back to its own rear. Watch uid0's heading: it stays fronted on the enemy for the whole withdrawal instead of pivoting 180 degrees and marching off, so the slot grid never sweeps through a half-turn the soldier bodies cannot follow. TIMING IS LOAD-BEARING: the right-click must land AFTER the enemy reaches the tired unit, because a right-click on a friendly that is not yet fighting resolves to a plain ground MOVE instead of a RELIEF -- there is nothing to relieve yet. SPACING: the three blocks deploy with clear ground between them. uid1 at y=300 stands on y 237-363 and uid0 at y=470 on y 407-533, so the reliever no longer deploys inside the tired unit's rear ranks (at y=390 the two overlapped by about 46 wu). The enemy at y=620 stands on y 566-674, 33 wu short of uid0's front rank, so the pair are not in contact at deployment (at y=570 they were, from the first sample); the enemy closes and uid0 is FIGHTING from tick 72 on seeds 0-4, well before the tick-200 click. SELECTION IS LOAD-BEARING: a box selects a unit whose men (grown by a body radius), regiment point, block centre or raised standard falls inside it, and uid0's standard is drawn above its block, over uid1's ground near x=805. The old box [700,350]..[900,430] took in uid0's rear ranks, so both player units were selected and the click became a ground MOVE for both, with no RELIEF on any seed. The box [690,250]..[760,350] takes only uid1's left files, west of that standard. The expects pin the outcome: uid1 on a RELIEF from the click and still on it, FIGHTING, at tick 500, with the enemy's target moved onto it; uid0 on its MOVE and still MOVING at tick 500; and uid0's facing within 0.05 of (0, 1) at every sampled tick from 300 to 500. The 0.05 tolerance is about 3 degrees: facing is dumped to 2 decimals and uid0's x component read -0.02 to 0.01 on seeds 0-4, while a 180-degree pivot reads (0, -1) and the unrelieved block on main drifts to an x of 0.13-0.79 by tick 500.
